description:
Trigger: a positive-path test fails and prints its panic message.

src/lib.rs line 2396 (smime_individual_givenname_surname_form_passes): panic message says 'policy OID 2.23.140.1.5.4.1' (Legacy generation). The fixture and the test require 2.23.140.1.5.4.3 (Strict). Migration was done in PKIX-jbvb.6.

src/lib.rs line 2569 (smime_sponsor_givenname_surname_form_passes): same issue — panic message says 'policy OID 2.23.140.1.5.3.1' (Legacy) instead of .3.3 (Strict).

Bad behavior: if either test fails for some unrelated reason (e.g., a fixture regeneration drops the OID), the panic message will lie about which OID the test expected, sending the debugger to look for a banned-Legacy-OID mismatch that doesn't exist. The whole point of these tests is to discriminate Strict from Legacy/Mailbox; the diagnostic strings invert that discrimination.
title: Stale Legacy OID in test panic messages (lib.rs:2396, 2569)
